responsibility: Declares the SymbolKey API for a binary-tree symbol table that maps NameKey identifiers to symbol numbers and supports initialization, destruction, lookup, insertion, deletion, traversal, membership checks, and conditional counting. It is the public tree-based symbol-map interface built on top of NameKey rather than a global string interning service.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations for the SymbolKey tree API, using an opaque SymbolTree handle and callback typedefs, while gcc/m2/pge-boot/GSymbolKey.cc contains the concrete node structure and implements the binary-tree operations.
